counterhypotheses.claim: Canonical semantic hash/parity is sufficient for release evidence; extra byte/build/admission identity is redundant bureaucracy.
counterhypotheses.supporting_external: SLSA provenance explicitly records subject digest plus build type, parameters and resolved dependencies, weakening the sufficiency claim rather than supporting it.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Hold semantic hash constant while changing selected surface/build input or tested bytes; accept only if an explicit equivalence/provenance receipt proves the same admitted artifact.

counterhypotheses.claim: The apparently sparse historical NAcc call surface is a static-search artifact; most or all defined channels may be active through aliases, dynamic dispatch or unsearched paths.
counterhypotheses.supporting_internal: Static archaeology explicitly marks absence as UNKNOWN until H1 instrumentation.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Instrument every runtime reward invocation and downstream E-PQ/reentry effect over frozen golden traces plus autonomous/idle paths.

counterhypotheses.claim: Targeted dependency routing is unsafe when projections are incomplete/stale and can miss high-impact invalidations; dense broadcast may dominate after repair/control overhead.
counterhypotheses.supporting_internal: Deterministic 5,000-delta simulation with 8% missing observed edges produced 603 missed required deliveries and only 92.02% perfect-event recall before repair.
counterhypotheses.supporting_external: Incremental dataflow/IVM are analogues, not proof; NATS transport permits duplicate/redelivered application observations under failure modes.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Real-repo matched broadcast/tag-only/adaptive replay with missing-edge/stale-epoch/duplicate/reorder/restart faults and total resource accounting.

counterhypotheses.claim: A same-database live observer is operationally harmless and isolation adds needless latency/complexity.
counterhypotheses.supporting_external: SQLite WAL permits concurrent readers/writers but has one writer and checkpoints/locks can block or return SQLITE_BUSY, so harmlessness is workload-dependent.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Matched no-observer vs same-file observer vs isolated observer on current SQLite family; compare writer p50/p95/p99, SQLITE_BUSY/retries, WAL bytes, checkpoint latency, replay correctness and end-to-end stale window.

counterhypotheses.claim: A simple scalar causal-outcome reward is sufficient; feature-specific or multihorizon typed reward adds complexity without control benefit.
counterhypotheses.supporting_external: Recent dopamine literature challenges a single homogeneous scalar account but is only a biological/computational analogue, not Frank-specific evidence.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Historical measured reward function vs scalar causal-outcome vs typed vs typed+multihorizon under matched episodes, stability and resource shadows.

counterhypotheses.claim: A broker's exactly-once mode can stand in for Clay effect idempotency and authority checks.
counterhypotheses.supporting_external: JetStream exactly-once uses publication deduplication and double acknowledgements for broker delivery/consumption; it does not independently verify arbitrary downstream external effects or Clay authority.
counterhypotheses.discriminator: Crash after external effect but before semantic effect receipt; verify replay cannot duplicate the effect even when broker delivery is not repeated.

rule: Counterhypotheses remain alternatives/failure modes; none is promoted merely by external resemblance.
